LESSON: BELIEF IN THE LAST DAY HELLFIRE

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Pillars of Iman
Topic 3.1: Belief in the Last Day Hellfire

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Belief in the Last Day Hellfire. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: Why is it important for Muslims to believe in the Last Day?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. describe the events of the Last Day for accountability

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: BELIEF IN THE LAST DAY HELLFIRE
This lesson teaches Belief in the Last Day Hellfire for Grade 9 ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION.

STUDY STEPS
1. describe the events of the Last Day for accountability
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Belief in the Last Day Hellfire using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Belief in the Last Day Hellfire above.
2. Explain Belief in the Last Day Hellfire to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Belief in the Last Day Hellfire.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Belief in the Last Day Hellfire with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Belief in the Last Day Hellfire important for a Grade 9 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why is it important for Muslims to believe in the Last Day?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. describe the events of the Last Day for accountability

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.
